Details

Non-woven abrasive wheels combine nylon fibre with abrasive grain in an open, flexible structure. The wheel conforms to the workpiece surface, so it gives a uniform finish without gouging and runs cooler than bonded grinding wheels.

FAQ

Can this wheel be made in custom sizes?

Yes. Diameter, width, bore and grade can be customised under our OEM/ODM service. Contact us with your drawing or target specification.

Does it change the dimensions of the part?

Non-woven abrasives remove very little material, so they are suited to finishing and light deburring rather than heavy stock removal.
